writtenBy: migrated by hand from the FLOORS and STEPS constants in code (#90). It predates the recalibrate command and fingerprints, so it is stale until `eval/recalibrate.py generation` rewrites it from five judged runs (#91, ADR-0012). Never edit by hand.
rule: three judged runs of the Shipped Arm over the 107-case Golden Set (ADR-0007, before ADR-0012); step = the smallest of 0.005/0.01/0.02/0.05/0.1 no smaller than the metric's held-out range; Floor = lowest run − max(2 × range, step) over all cases, rounded down to the step; values to three places, as docs/evaluation.md published them
